text: APPROVE. The new `MatchesRequested` helper plus `entry.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object && ...` preserves the original logic exactly (skip non-objects, return the first object when no version is requested, otherwise return only an exact ordinal `num` match, else null), and it removes the nested branches that drove the complexity down from 17 to well under 15. The helper is a plain private static method with consistent nullability, so I see no new build warnings, though I haven't compiled it.
